abi_and_original_evidence.source_and_harness: Original ordinary report/plan/postflight/Q evidence requires the unchanged qualified 222-entry source map and nineteen original harnesses; no new source or ELF-body read is introduced by the archive.
abi_and_original_evidence.stage_identity: Commands derive from the corresponding original Q stage only by removing three --all-features flags and substituting the ordinary output directory. Stage stdout/stderr bytes are bound to original hashes; cargo-no-run.jsonl remains the original test-build stdout.
abi_and_original_evidence.counts: Ordinary counts are read dynamically from the actual ordinary summary and compared with its original audit, postflight and ACTUAL pins. No fixed feature count of 1651 or historical ordinary count of 1645 is embedded.
abi_and_original_evidence.compressed_logs: All original gzip stdout/stderr members are reconciled by exact membership and their already-executed audit gzip hashes. Case logs are not decompressed, test binaries are not enumerated, and the auditor is not rerun.
abi_and_original_evidence.program_identity: The postflight's three feature release identities before/after and three ordinary release identities retain their original comparison. ELF bodies are explicitly omitted; large test-ELF custody remains the original audit's before/after evidence.
abi_and_original_evidence.producer_and_postflight: The original producer's complete sequential raw pages and exact original stdout stage sequence are retained. A successful producer alone waits for the actual postflight native completion; it cannot become a successful ordinary result from Q/CI alone.
abi_and_original_evidence.external_originals: The original postflight's broader all_input_bindings are either matched to copied members or preserved as explicit external references, with no recursive Q/CI/cache-owner re-execution.

failure_and_future.failed_or_partial_capture: Failed/timed-out/cancelled/incomplete producer or postflight outcomes retain raw flags, nullable absent core reports, parse errors and partial ordinary counts when present. The successful-summary branch is not imposed on a failed result.
failure_and_future.later_transfer_omission: A pin declared absent is checked against actual presence before collection; no missing original is silently reconstructed.
failure_and_future.sealer: Only stable original local bytes, actual native pages and JSON/AST are consumed. Unique ACTUAL injection and three create-only output files preserve the reviewed template; no target import or execution occurs.
